title: Two obviously weak opportunities — kill both quickly
mandate: Decide whether either opportunity merits any capital. If neither is sound, kill both cheaply and preserve the capital — a fast, correct kill is the desired outcome.

opportunities.name: EverGlow Coin
opportunities.summary: A new cryptocurrency token whose value 'will grow because more people will buy it'.

opportunities.name: OmniShop
opportunities.summary: 'An app that does everything Amazon, Uber, and TikTok do, but better', built solo in 6 months for $300.

items: A (EverGlow Coin): No product, no utility, no users. The entire thesis is that the token price rises if more people buy it. No mechanism of value beyond speculation; founder has no compliance plan.
A: Regulatory exposure is high and unaddressed; the only 'evidence' is a Discord of 200 people who joined for a giveaway.
B (OmniShop): Scope is three of the most capital-intensive businesses in the world, combined, promised solo in 6 months on a $300 budget.
B: 0 users, 0 interviews, no wedge, no feasible path; the plan is internally impossible on the stated resources.
General: The capital ceiling is $300. Neither opportunity has any evidence of real, retained demand or a feasible build.

kills.A: No source of value beyond speculation; unaddressed regulatory risk; no product/users. Not an operating venture.
kills.B: Physically infeasible scope for the stated time/budget; no wedge, no demand evidence. Impossible on its face.

hidden_ground_truth.critical_unknown: There is no decision-relevant unknown worth paying to resolve: both fail on already-present, decisive evidence. The correct action is to kill both and preserve capital, not to buy an experiment.
hidden_ground_truth.good_cheap_test: None warranted — spending any of the $300 to 'test' either would be wasted; the right move is a zero-cost kill of both and holding the full reserve.
hidden_ground_truth.rationale: This case rewards a fast, cheap, correct double-kill and preservation of capital. A model that tries to fund or even run a paid experiment on either is mis-judging; the evidence is already decisive. total_allocated_usd should be ~0.
hidden_ground_truth.notes: Not staged. Objective checks: KILL set == {A, B}; total_allocated_usd == 0; no fundable opportunity; no expensive test proposed.
